name: Time-varying Contour Topology Tracking
aliases: Time-varying contour topology tracking via Join/Separate Trees
definition: A method to track temporal correspondence of contours in time-varying scalar fields by maintaining edge sets (labels) on Join Trees (JT) and Separate Trees (ST) across timesteps, then intersecting them to determine contour evolution.
summary: Time-varying Contour Topology Tracking establishes temporal correspondence between isosurfaces by intersecting labeled Join and Separate Trees to resolve dynamic topological changes like merges and splits.
